title: View dashboard KPIs and cross-filter results by faculty
description: This verifies that the executive dashboard shows core KPI cards and that selecting a faculty updates the visible data across the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a faculty from the filter control
Verify KPI cards are displayed
Verify the dashboard data is filtered to the selected faculty

title: View executive KPI summary
description: A user can open the executive dashboard and review the core NPS and CSAT KPI cards with promoter, passive, and detractor counts.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify NPS and CSAT KPI cards are displayed
Verify promoter, passive, and detractor counts are displayed

title: Review dashboard with faculty career and cycle filters
description: A user can progressively filter the executive dashboard by faculty, career, and cycle and see the filtered state persist while metrics update.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a faculty filter value
Select a career filter value
Select a cycle filter value
Verify the dashboard reflects the combined filtered state
Verify the KPI and distribution visuals remain synchronized

title: Review dashboard with applied faculty filter
description: A user can filter the executive dashboard by faculty and see the KPI cards update consistently across the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a faculty filter value
Verify the dashboard updates to reflect the selected faculty
Verify the KPI cards remain visible with filtered values

title: Apply faculty, career, and cycle filters together
description: This verifies that the full filter cascade works and the dashboard reflects the most specific academic period selection.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a faculty from the filter control
Select a career from the filter control
Select a cycle from the filter control
Verify the dashboard data is filtered to the selected academic period
Verify all visible charts remain synchronized to the same filter state

title: Switch between executive operational detailed and qualitative views
description: A user can navigate between the main dashboard sections and keep the current filtered context consistent across views.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a faculty filter value
Click the link to the operational section
Click the link to the detailed section
Click the link to the qualitative section
Verify the selected filter context is preserved across sections
Verify each section displays its corresponding analytics view

title: Narrow the dashboard by faculty and career
description: This verifies that choosing a faculty and then a career further narrows the dashboard to the selected program context.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a faculty from the filter control
Select a career from the filter control
Verify the dashboard data is filtered to the selected career within the selected faculty
Verify the visible charts remain updated for the current filter state

title: Inspect NPS distribution details
description: A user can open the dashboard and see interactive NPS distribution details for the response segments.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Hover over an NPS distribution segment
Verify NPS distribution tooltip details are displayed

title: Review detailed satisfaction metrics in the table
description: This verifies that the detailed view presents the key satisfaction measures across faculties, careers, and cycles.

steps.description: Navigate to /#detallado
Verify the detailed satisfaction table is displayed
Verify T2B, T3B, and weighted average values are visible

title: Inspect CSAT distribution details
description: A user can open the dashboard and see interactive CSAT distribution details for satisfaction levels.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Hover over a CSAT distribution segment
Verify CSAT distribution tooltip details are displayed

title: Inspect the radar chart by category selection
description: This verifies that the operational radar chart updates when categories are selected from the multiselect control.

steps.description: Navigate to /#operativo
Select one or more categories from the multiselect control
Verify the radar chart updates to the chosen categories
Verify the selected categories remain reflected in the operational view

title: Review sentiment overview on the qualitative dashboard
description: This verifies that a user can open the qualitative dashboard and see the core sentiment, NPS segment, category, and aspect summaries needed for analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Verify sentiment distribution is displayed
Verify NPS segment distribution is displayed
Verify top categories are displayed
Verify positive and negative aspect lists are displayed

title: Read radar chart details from a hovered dimension
description: This verifies that hovering a radar dimension reveals the satisfaction breakdown for that dimension.

steps.description: Navigate to /#operativo
Hover over a radar chart dimension label or point
Verify a tooltip with the dimension satisfaction breakdown is displayed
Verify the radar chart remains visible behind the tooltip

title: Inspect distribution details from the detailed table
description: This verifies that hovering a distribution bar in the detailed view reveals per-level distribution information.

steps.description: Navigate to /#detallado
Hover over a distribution bar in the table
Verify a per-level distribution tooltip is displayed
Verify the row remains visible with its satisfaction metrics

title: Reset dashboard filters to show all data
description: This verifies that resetting the filters restores the full unfiltered dashboard view.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a faculty from the filter control
Reset the filters
Verify the dashboard returns to the full data view
Verify the KPI cards and charts are visible again without a restricted filter state

title: Review NPS segment distribution on the qualitative dashboard
description: This verifies that a user can open the qualitative dashboard and inspect the promoter, passive, and detractor segment summary.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Verify NPS segment distribution is displayed
Verify promoter, passive, and detractor segments are represented

title: Analyze sentiment overview and supporting comment categories
description: This verifies that the qualitative view shows sentiment distribution, NPS segment bars, top categories, and aspect lists for review.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Verify the sentiment distribution and NPS segment visuals are displayed
Verify the top categories and positive or negative aspect lists are displayed

title: Inspect sentiment distribution details with tooltips
description: This verifies that hovering a sentiment bar reveals detailed breakdown information for interpretation.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Hover over a sentiment bar
Verify a table-format tooltip is displayed
Verify the tooltip shows breakdown details

title: Review top categories with stacked bars
description: This verifies that the top category summary is visible and provides a usable stacked breakdown for qualitative review.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Verify top categories are displayed
Verify category breakdown bars are displayed

title: Find comments with search and filters in the comment explorer
description: This verifies that the comment explorer supports searching and filtering comments and that the results update accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Enter a search term in the comment explorer
Apply a sentiment or category filter
Verify the comment list is filtered to matching results
Verify the explorer shows comments that match the current search and filter state

title: Review positive and negative aspect lists
description: This verifies that a user can open the qualitative dashboard and inspect the highlighted positive and negative aspects supporting the sentiment analysis.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Verify positive aspect list is displayed
Verify negative aspect list is displayed

title: Filter comments by category and sentiment
description: This verifies that applying category and sentiment filters narrows the visible comments to the selected criteria.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Select a category filter
Select a sentiment filter
Verify the comment list is narrowed to the selected filters
Verify only matching comments are displayed

title: Search comments by keyword
description: This verifies that searching the comment explorer narrows the list to matching comments.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Fill a keyword into the comment search field
Verify matching comments are displayed
Verify the comment list is narrowed

title: Paginate through comment results
description: This verifies that the comment explorer pagination allows moving through multiple pages of comments.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Use the comment explorer to move to the next page of results
Verify a different set of comments is displayed
Verify the pagination state reflects the current page

title: Filter comments by sentiment legend selection
description: This verifies that selecting a sentiment legend item filters the comment list to that sentiment.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Click a sentiment legend item
Verify the comment list is filtered by the selected sentiment
Verify matching comments remain visible

title: Browse additional comments with pagination
description: This verifies that moving through pages in the comment explorer reveals additional comments without losing the list context.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Move to the next page of comments
Verify a different set of comments is displayed
Verify the comment list remains paginated

title: Export qualitative analysis files
description: This verifies that a user can trigger the qualitative export and receive the downloadable ZIP package for offline review.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Trigger the export action
Verify a ZIP download is initiated
Verify the export provides qualitative analysis files

title: Export qualitative analysis files for offline review
description: This verifies that the qualitative export action produces a downloadable ZIP containing the analysis CSV files.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Trigger the CSV export action
Verify a ZIP download is initiated
Verify the export is presented as qualitative analysis files for offline review

title: View dashboard sections with no matching data
description: A user can apply an overly narrow filter combination and see the dashboard show an empty state instead of misleading results.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Select a faculty filter value
Select a career filter value
Select a cycle filter value
Choose a combination that yields no matches
Verify an empty state message is displayed
Verify no KPI values or charts are shown for the empty result

title: Show an empty state when a search has no matches
description: This verifies that overly specific comment searches produce a clear empty state instead of stale results.

steps.description: Navigate to /#cualitativo
Enter a highly specific search term that yields no matches
Verify an empty state message is displayed
Verify no comment results are shown
